oneSentenceConcept: The hero becomes a live, inspectable canvas where state rails, chapter markers, and precise motion reveal creative intelligence without changing content.
heroConcept: A near-black luxury-tech field with existing hero content assembled across a split grid, luminous state rails, evidence chips, and one scroll-scrubbed chapter line. The effect suggests an AI-native working surface while keeping navigation and portfolio structure stable.
experienceMood: intelligent, composed, observant, precise, quietly alive
emergingSignals: Canvas-native AI interfaces with visible edit state
Agentic product personalities encoded as controlled behavioral states
Robotics and AI storytelling centered on trust and coexistence
Sensory chapter systems for premium single-page narratives
Authorable motion timelines replacing custom-code spectacle
Editorial fluidity held by typographic grid discipline
visualLanguage: Luxury-tech restraint: deep spatial field, warm high-contrast type, thin inspection rails, and a mint signal accent used only for state, progress, and interactive evidence.
interactionLanguage: Hover reveals depth and system intent; scroll behaves like a calm canvas inspection rather than a forced journey; navigation remains stable with only subtle accent confirmation.
motionLanguage: Subtle staged assembly in the hero: rails draw in, markers resolve, and hierarchy settles. Supporting sections use light reveal pacing with no continuous ambient motion.
storytellingApproach: Hero-as-working-surface prologue; supporting sections become readable chapters that inherit rails, panels, and evidence rhythm while preserving existing content order.
creativeTechnologyIdeas: Token-driven state rails using CSS custom properties
Scroll-linked chapter progress limited to the hero band
Declarative AI-interface cues expressed as native panels and markers
Reduced-motion fallback that renders the completed canvas immediately
typographyDirection: Experimental but legible sans display with compact tracking in the hero; warm minimal body type and stable measure elsewhere.
compositionDirection: Split-grid hero with one dominant content column and a secondary system-observation column; supporting sections use grid rhythm and elevated panels.
colorDirection: Near-black foundation, warm parchment foreground, desaturated blue-gray surfaces, and a luminous mint accent reserved for state and interaction.
textureDirection: Fine-line interface rails, subdued panel elevation, and controlled surface depth; no grain, no decorative particles, and no heavy glass stacks.
supportingPageTreatment: Elevated cards and grid-rhythm sections inherit the hero's inspectable system language at reduced intensity; work grid remains clear and teaser-only.
avoid: Generic AI chat widgets or assistant mascots
Decorative glass blobs without visible state logic
Autoplay sound or sensory effects that need user control
Site-wide WebGL depth or particle environments
Randomized generated layouts that obscure hierarchy
Navigation experiments that compete with content
